changelog:
Initial release of Relationship OS—enabling AI agents to create richer, more human-like relationships with users.

- Implements event-based memory, capturing only relationship-changing moments, not all conversations.
- Adds open thread management for ongoing commitments, emotional follow-ups, and shared plans.
- Introduces exclusive memories (inside jokes, nicknames, shared goals) for each user relationship.
- Supports agent stance formation: the agent builds consistent, personal attitudes on recurring topics.
- Automates relationship stage progression, advancing interaction style based on depth and history.
- Optional selfie module to proactively share character images, if supported.
